correctness.rationale: Exact four-parameter Hermitian kernel exhaustively derived from four-point Fourier modes on all three squares. Exact 4×4 coefficient matrix of principal 3×3 minors has determinant 6064128; its forced vanishing yields c=0, when the explicit full determinant is strictly positive unless H=0. Rank≤2 kernel exclusion yields all-vector phase retrieval; compactness yields inverse-Lipschitz projector stability. A standalone exact SymPy program rechecks all algebraic identities.
